name: Demo Selenium JavaScript for Google Search
summary: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of Selenium WebDriver browser automation in JavaScript, written against Google Search's well-known, publicly documented markup.
description: This repo demonstrates Selenium WebDriver browser automation testing with JavaScript and Node.js, using Google Search (https://www.google.com) as a widely-known real-world example. It is written as three real, assertion-based checks: the home page title, the search box and resulting title, and the first result link. Because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of Google Search, this code is never run against the live site by this repo's own tooling, and must never be run automatically by CI or any other tooling.
